title: Development of small and medium-sized businesses is a priority for us- Economy minister

facts.fact: Minister Jabbarov addressed the 18th annual meeting of the International Network for SMEs (INSME).
facts.quote: he addressed the 18th International Network for SMEs (INSME) annual meeting

facts.fact: The INSME annual meeting was titled "Empowering SMEs: Economic diversification and green growth" and was co-organized by KOBIA and the INSME.
facts.quote: on "Empowering SMEs: Economic diversification and green growth" co-organized by KOBIA and the INSME.

facts.fact: Minister Jabbarov stated that the development of small and medium-sized businesses characterizes the rate of development of any country's economy.
facts.quote: the development of small and medium-sized businesses characterizes the rate of development of any country’s economy
